description.narrative: Women's Rights Action Movement is one of the few feminist organizations in the Solomon Islands leading work on legislative reform for women's rights and political participation. Their action research methodology has been effective to influencing transformational policy change for women and girls including support for women candidates at the provincial and national levels and passing of the country's first legislation on domestic violence. WRAM has been particularly active in strengthening networks of WROs in the Asia-Pacfic region, collaborating on women's rights campaigns, and convening national and regional spaces for exchange, development of organizational capacity and feminist leadership of young women and girls. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities 1. Staff salaries 2. Advocacy and Consultation with stakeholders 3. Training of trainers
